[!dolt] skip
# Test bd blocked only shows blocked work
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Blocker' --description 'Needed first' --json
extractid BLOCKER
bd create 'Blocked' --description 'Waiting on blocker' --json
extractid BLOCKED
bd dep add $BLOCKED $BLOCKER
stdout 'Added dependency'

bd blocked
stdout 'Blocked'
! stdout 'Blocker'
